lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in four visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with relatively uniform spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the lateral line.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Discrete high-luminance spots are visible along the anterior margin and dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
